name: CorporateTravelRequestApprovals
tagline: Pre-trip requests with live policy checks, tiered approvals, budgets and booking hand-off – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete corporate travel request app for Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages. Travellers raise trip requests with cost estimates; the app checks advance booking, cabin class, city hotel caps and cost-centre budgets live, requires a justification for exceptions, routes requests through manager, finance and security approvals and hands approved trips to the travel desk to be booked with the PNR and actual cost.
features: Live policy check in the request form
Approve all in-policy requests in one click
Return for changes / reject / cancel with reasons
Cost-centre budgets with committed vs pending
Booking hand-off board with PNR and cost variance
Bulk actions, filters, grouping, CSV export
Undo, keyboard support, phone layout with bottom bar
Low-code setup: column mappings, ';' lists, no JSON
